entries.zh: 尼姑；庵中老年女性修行者（西士以“女祭司”视佛庵女众）
entries.en: A priestess; a Buddhist nun or old woman attached to a convent.

entries.zh: 包、袋；西文 saco 参见 bolsa。
entries.en: bag or sack; the Spanish saco cross-refers to bolsa
entries.notes: Juan Gil（2019–2020）第 71 页引影印本 p.903 的 saco q; bolsa，将 q; 释为参见；现封存记作 y，符号字形待核。

entries.zh: 布袋；盛装干粮、行粮用的布口袋
entries.en: A cloth sack; a bag for provisions (matalotaje).

entries.zh: 祭；祭祀，向神明祖先奉献牺牲
醮；建醮，道士设坛酬神的祭祀法会（古义亦指婚宴敬酒）
entries.en: A sacrificial ceremony (Taoist offering); archaically also the wedding feast.

entries.zh: 牙；做牙，每月初二、十六祭祀土地神（牙祭）
entries.en: The offering made on the 2nd and 16th of each month (to the earth god).

entries.zh: 供养；供奉，以香火、饮食供佛神与祖先
entries.en: To make offerings to the Buddha, gods, or ancestors.

entries.zh: 道场；道士设坛诵经做法事的祭祀仪式（或其坛场）
entries.en: A ritual arena; a place and ceremony of sacrifice with prayers.

entries.zh: 祭葬；丧葬祭祀，祭奠与安葬
entries.en: Sacrifice and burial; funerary rites for the dead.

entries.zh: 祝愿；在家向神像许愿祝祷（原件第二字难辨，释义存疑）
entries.en: To vow and pray before the household idol.
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅辨“祝”，第二字疑为“愿”（疑录愆/愿），据闽南语原稿 chiog guan 与西语“在家祭神像”语境定为祝愿、祝祷义，存疑。

entries.zh: 下祝；在家中神像前祝祷行祭
entries.en: To perform an invocation before the household idol.

entries.zh: 稷；五谷之神，君王所祭的谷神
entries.en: The god of grain; the sacrifice the king offers to him.

entries.zh: 社稷；土地神与五谷神（王者所祭，代指国家）
entries.en: The gods of soil and grain; the altars of the state.

entries.zh: 郊天；天子于国郊祭天的大祀
entries.en: The suburban sacrifice to Heaven offered by the sovereign.

entries.zh: 丧礼；为亡者所行的丧祭之礼
entries.en: Funeral rites; sacrifice for the dead.

entries.zh: 郎君会；侍奉庙中神明的男子会社（神明会，职司神庙祭祀事务）
entries.en: A lay men's association serving the temple idol, acting as its sacristan.
